description:
Baek Heon, the ruthless CEO of the criminal syndicate Yusu, finds himself under investigation by prosecutor Seol Ji-Hun for allegedly plotting to assassinate a congressman. Inside the interrogation room, Baek Heon becomes instantly captivated by Ji-Hun and makes a chilling decision. If he’s going to hell, he’s taking this good-looking prosecutor down with him. Ji-Hun’s life is soon upended. Framed for crimes he didn’t commit, he ends up behind bars, his once-promising future shattered. But Baek Heon isn’t done yet. For a man who confesses his deepest desire is to ruin a prosecutor, he’s more than ready to drag Ji-Hun into his world of obsession and poison—and Ji-Hun might just be daring enough to see how far he’ll fall.

(Source: Lezhin US)
